{{Quote|The Empire could not have succeeded without treachery. I only know they used some kind of time-release poison, then "arrested" them as they lay unconscious.|[[Akaavi Spar]]|<ref name="TOR:ZL">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Akaavi Spar|Zadik Lone}}</ref>}}
The '''22nd Regiment''' was a [[Regiment/Legends|regiment]] within the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. It was responsible for the destruction of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Clan Spar]].<ref name="TORE" />
